description: Shared rule request v1 fixtures. valid entries round-trip through the URL. invalid entries are URLs and name the first problem in checkOrder. rejectedInputs are createRuleRequest values that are not URLs. Amounts in expect are decimal strings. A plus sign in a query value is a plus sign, not a space. purposeMaxBytes is PURPOSE_MAX_LEN from programs/veto/src/state.rs, applied as UTF-8 bytes because the mandate account stores that many bytes. labelMaxChars counts Unicode code points.
